notes.title: REWORKED FLASHLIGHT & SPRAY UPDATE
notes.content: [h2]Additions[/h2][p][/p][h3]Flashlight[/h3][p][/p][p]-Reworked the flashlight logic and changed its UI[/p][p]-Added flashlight in hand to CO-OP[/p][p]-Increased time before flashlight overheating[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/5594ea3dc03d6574faa58f98e3f982a04c85163b.png"][/img][/p][h3]Spray[/h3][p][/p][p]-Reduced time between spray uses[/p][p]-Now [u][i]you can change a spray image[/i][/u] to your own in pause menu[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/4cf8cf705c655333a61629e6e53aefc557af4a5a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/174bea3fad651767fa304b6e44bd538a3f7fab72.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]Other[/h3][p][/p][p]-Now you can hear other players footsteps[/p][p]-In the CO-OP lobby stamina will no longer be drained[/p][p]-Added "I'm Stuck" button to CO-OP (will be added to singleplayer in future)[/p][p][/p][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][p][/p][p]-Fixed a bug with the FoV when entering a level and pressing the zoom button the FoV will be reset to the default value[/p][p]-Fixed a bug that caused the host to not display correctly in the pause menu[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Thank you all for your support. [/b][/i][/p][p][i][b]Stay tune for more[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]My Discord server: [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/hyUpPPG8X6"]https://discord.com/invite/hyUpPPG8X6[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: CO-OP LOBBY + SUMMER EVENT UPDATE
notes.content: [h2][b]NEW CO-OP LOBBY UPDATE + SUMMER EVENT HAS ARRIVED![/b][/h2][h2][/h2][p][/p][h3]Additions[/h3][p][/p][p]-Added [u]two new skins[/u] and new dance emote [/p][list][*][p][i]the first skin and emote can be purchased from a trader on Level 1247[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]the second skin can be earned in a new mini-game[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]-Updated the CO-OP lobby to create a summer mood ː2016watermelonː[/p][p]-Expanded CO-OP lobby map with new interactions[/p][p]-A 2 new mini-games has been added![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/b26d3eab56dd1f8052e88ba6462c73a8c1c44ca2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/526a8e5d4e78be81b010414a2f72f7e0186c52e1.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/431d14d77b0c8682110232f27d80f575e4671656.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/794d4cd43ef31b1f5b0f1b76571b12b5ea847669.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][p]-Fixed a bug where FoV settings were reset to default when traveling to any CO-OP level[/p][p]-Fixed a bug with the basketball game where the ball would get stuck in the wall when pulling the lever[/p][p]-Fixed a bug that could cause the jump animation to loop[/p][p][/p][p][i]In the next update there will be a new CO-OP level that can be completed alone.[/i][/p][p][i]This level will be the last one, after this update I will be improving features that are already in the game and after that the game will move from early access to full release.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Thank you all for your support. [/b][/i][/p][p][i][b]Stay tune for more[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]My Discord server: [url="https://discord.com/invite/hyUpPPG8X6"]https://discord.com/invite/hyUpPPG8X6[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Small Update (Controls change, Level 0 and Level 43 improvements, bug fixes)
notes.content:
[b]This update features new Controls change menu, Level 0 and Level 43 improvements + bug fixes[/b]


Additions and changes:
-Added control menu!
-Added new mobs on Levels 0 and 43.
-Added spectate mode [i](similar to Level 232.2)[/i] after player's dies from a mob on Levels 0 and 43
-Changed notes logic on Levels 0 and 43
-Changed level selection widget in CO-OP
-Changed ambient sound on singleplayer Level 9
-Slightly changed the singleplayer menu
-Improved mob logic on Levels 0 and 43
-Improved graphics and performance on level 43

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/ecc0968d0d25cdae8e1dd08bf3c5f0529ab68826.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/4e65c911588f8bb749ffaed8220c0cd7617b260d.png[/img]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug on Level 43 where mobs could teleport or run at you while you were looking at them, also reduced mob shaking.
-Fixed a bug with outfit appearance on Levels 0 and 43.
-Fixed a bug with entities on Levels 0 and 43 where after mob catches player, the player's screen could freeze with the face of the mob.
-Fixed a few minor bugs


[b]Next update will be fixing bugs and adding more stuff to the game![/b]


[i][b]Thank you all for your support.
Stay tune for more[/b][/i]



My Discord server: https://discord.gg/8enqq3EV

notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE HAS ARRIVED + CHANGES ON LEVEL 0
notes.content:
[b][i]Christmas update is here + some changes in CO-OP Level 0[/i][/b]


[i]Additions[/i]

-The CO-OP lobby now has Christmas decor and a new small location
-New locations have been added to CO-OP Level 0 for exploration
-Added a Christmas hat for all players
-Camera Shake option added


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/7d4e46a4af241b5b90d4bec19550b4143557e64d.png[/img]


[i]Bug Fixes[/i]

-Fixed a bug that could cause the jump animation to get stuck
-Fixed some collisions
-Corrected the name on tape 1 and 2 on Level 0


[i][b]You can get a Christmas scanner skin in the CO-OP lobby![/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/e3d210043b270fddc79e12ee9ffc5518b7a26a1c.png[/img]


All you have to do is collect all the Christmas gifts in the CO-OP lobby, after that you can enter the staircase doors, where you'll find a gift that will give you a scanner skin.



[u][b]Merry Christmas to all of you and thank you for your support![/b][/u]



Stay tune for more.


My Discord server: https://discord.gg/v89cANSsPR
